# Google Groups

> Google Groups is a collaborative communication platform enabling organizations, communities, and teams to create discussion forums, manage group memberships, and facilitate knowledge sharing across diverse domains.

Google Groups hosts thousands of communities ranging from professional development and technical support to academic collaboration and organizational management. Groups serve as centralized hubs for email communication, discussion moderation, and group-based access control across educational institutions, technology companies, nonprofits, and international organizations.

## Key Topics

- Google Groups
- Group Management
- Community of Practice
- Technical Support
- Group Membership
- Email Communication

## Developer & Technical Communities

- [Amara API Users](https://groups.google.com/a/amara.org/g/api-users): Amara API developer community for API updates and technical support
- [Android CameraX Discussion Group](https://groups.google.com/a/android.com/g/camerax-developers): Android CameraX developer community for camera library technical support

## Learning & Educational Communities

- [Future Learning Experiences](https://groups.google.com/a/adlnet.gov/g/future-learning-experiences): ADL Future Learning Experiences discussion forum for instructional design
- [Asian Pacific American Studies](https://groups.google.com/a/amherst.edu/g/5asam-l): Amherst College Asian Pacific American Studies academic group
- [Rete ANILS Tecnologie didattiche](https://groups.google.com/a/anils.it/g/rete-anils-tecnologie-didattiche): ANILS network group for educational technology collaboration in Italy

## Professional & Organizational Communities

- [The Dynamic Accountability Community of Practice](https://groups.google.com/a/accountablenow.org/g/dacop): Dynamic Accountability Community of Practice group on Google Groups
- [AMVNC Committee](https://groups.google.com/a/amvnc.org/g/committee): AMVNC Committee group for organizational collaboration and permissions
- [Acole Prints](https://groups.google.com/a/acoleprints.shop/g/acoleprints): Acole Prints organization group for email communication and management

## Marketplace & Community Exchange

- [Japanese real estate listings by Agathon](https://groups.google.com/a/agathon.co.jp/g/jp_real_estate_listing): Agathon Japanese real estate property listings marketplace group
- [Intercambio virtual de libros Curso 2025-2026](https://groups.google.com/a/ampaiesgrancapitan.org/g/mercadillo-online-libros-de-texto25-26): Virtual textbook exchange marketplace for school course 2025-2026
